sections.Profile:
"Royal Flush Deluxe," released by Gottlieb in June 1983, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a card game theme. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by David Moore and Terry Doerzaph, the machine includes two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball. It uses the Gottlieb System 80A hardware and has a digital display.
